tuition.note: Bachelor, about 2,500 AED per credit hour (12-16 credits per semester); housing and transport extra

requirement.text: Completed Grade 12 (or equivalent) within the last two years with Mathematics and one science, meeting curriculum minimums (e.g. IB 24 points, 80% for American/CBSE); IELTS Academic 6.0 or TOEFL iBT 79; attested certificates, video interview and KU Admission Tests for shortlisted applicants.
